communication_goal: 说明相关工作经验，并用一个项目展示自己的技能。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers sit side by side at a small desk. The developer on the left gestures confidently toward an open laptop at the center while the teammate on the right listens. The laptop is fully visible, with screen and keyboard, and its screen contains only a few abstract architecture blocks connected by lines. One coffee mug away from the laptop is fine. The scene is a calm introduction of prior work; do not write a resume or text.

coverage_review.scope: W002 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：两名成年火柴人围坐桌边讨论开发经历，打开的笔记本电脑完整可见，屏幕为无字架构符号。experience/backend/project由对白提供语境证据，不从简图推断个人资历或技术栈。
